typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	CPSUIArchiveFolder as string (),
	CPSUIArchiveScrubFullPath as string (),
	CPSUIArchiveTriggerFullPath as string (),
	CPSUIArchiveTriggerTemplatePath as string (),
	CPSUIDncFolder as string (),
	CPSUIDncScrubFullPath as string (),
	CPSUIDncTriggerFullPath as string (),
	CPSUIFileName as string (),
	CPSUIScrubFileName as string (),
	CPSUITriggerFileName as string (),
	TimeStamp as string ()
}

source(output(
		DATAROW as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT 	CONCAT ( 		 \'HR\', \'|\' 		,FORMAT(GETDATE(), \'yyyyMMdd\'), \'|\' 		,\'100229\', \'|\' 		,\'102\', \'|\' 		,\'100\', \'|\' 		,\'RegulatoryComplianceReporting\', \'|\' 		,\'TNMONO\' 		) AS DATAROW UNION ALL  SELECT 	 CONCAT(Phone, \'|\',PATIENT_IDENTIFIER, PHONE)  FROM [EXTRACT].[TN_MONOGRAM_STAGING_ANTHEM_MEMBERCONTACT] WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(Phone,\' \',\'\'))) <> \'\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Column_0 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = DATAROW)) ~> CREATESCRUBINFILE
